author: Lost LeBlanc
description:
Chiapas is one of those places people say you shouldn't visit and while no place is perfect. Chiapas is by far one of those adventures you have to go and experience from one of the most beautiful waterfalls to the city streets that feel like kuzco, Peru. Chiapas is an adventure and hidden gem.
